description:
Parks, playgrounds, sports grounds and courts, public swimming pools, gyms, beaches, skate parks, dog parks, golf courses and nature reserves: counts in the suburb, rates per 1,000 residents and distance from the suburb centre to the nearest of each.

Coverage: All Australian suburbs and localities. Current to 2026-10-01. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/parks-and-recreation`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: count_parks, per_1000_parks, nearest_km_parks, count_playgrounds, per_1000_playgrounds, nearest_km_playgrounds, count_sports_grounds, per_1000_sports_grounds, nearest_km_sports_grounds, count_swimming_pools, per_1000_swimming_pools, nearest_km_swimming_pools, count_gyms, per_1000_gyms, nearest_km_gyms, count_beaches, per_1000_beaches, nearest_km_beaches, count_skate_parks, per_1000_skate_parks, nearest_km_skate_parks, count_dog_parks, per_1000_dog_parks, nearest_km_dog_parks, count_golf_courses, per_1000_golf_courses, nearest_km_golf_courses, count_nature_reserves, per_1000_nature_reserves, nearest_km_nature_reserves, count_total, per_1000_total, per_km2_total. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_amenities_parks_and_recreation
